scenarios.title: In a fresh private HOME and QUIRKY_HOME with a supported agent dock, type a draft, click Attach, choose a run-created valid PNG in the OS file dialog, verify its named removable chip without draft loss, and remove only that chip. Never send to a real account or use the normal profile.
scenarios.summary: Attach opens the macOS Open panel with the draft kept, but the harness can't drive that separate panel window (keys returned delivery_failed), so the PNG wasn't chosen.
